translations: And if they incline to peace
then you (also) incline to it and put (your) trust
puzzle.hint: A divine instruction on embracing peace and placing full trust in Allah, even in times of conflict.
puzzle.arabic: ۞ وَإِن جَنَحُوا۟ لِلسَّلْمِ فَٱجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
puzzle.verseEn: And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing.
